scope: Invented permission/source regressions and real-model calls with synthetic tools; no microphone, camera, motor or household data.
fixed: Commands in supplied message words cannot grant explicit permission. Recognised message content without an actual request in its introduction creates no memory/sharing proposal or write. Full-utterance refusals and fresh yes remain conservative.
limits: Punctuation-based introduction check only, not all reported speech, languages or paraphrases. A non-explicit memory call can prepare a question; only matching readback/fresh yes can subsequently release its write. Existing credential-value check remains in force.
